The map

Fourteen coefficients fold the plane through absolute-value powers. Each mark is an actual iterate; nothing connects successive points. Traveling waves gently bend the form as the camera zooms and turns. Wave strength controls this display-only deformation; zero restores the unwarped portrait. All motion shares one seamless loop. Disable Cyclic to hold either camera control still. Dense-core framing uses the 1st–99th coordinate percentiles to keep rare excursions from shrinking the form; switch to full extent to see their scale.

x′ = a₀ + a₁x + a₂y
   + a₃|x|^a₄ + a₅|y|^a₆
y′ = b₀ + b₁x + b₂y
   + b₃|x|^b₄ + b₅|y|^b₆
Discovery screens finite bounded orbits for positive finite-time stretching and coverage. Roundness measures covariance isotropy; balance compares density with its half-turn. These rank candidates, without adding symmetry or proving chaos. Nearby search mixes local mutations with occasional broad changes.
General 2D map by Antonio Sánchez, via Paul Bourke. Presets were discovered for this study, starting near his second example.
